entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To connect to an agent, please press 1.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I... I need to make a return. I ordered a jersey and it just didn't work out. I'm so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just the wrong size. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and this has never happened. The jersey is just way too tight across the shoulders. I can't even move properly in it.
I understand, getting the right fit is crucial. Let me just pull up your order information. One moment.
Okay. I just... with the holidays here, I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out. I feel awful about it.
There's no need to feel awful, we'll get this sorted out. I see the order here, it was delivered 17 days ago. That's not a problem at all. You are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried.
Absolutely. I can process this for a full refund right now. Or, if you'd prefer, we could do an exchange for the next size up?
You know, I think I'd just prefer the refund for now. Thank you so much for making this easy. You've really turned my day around.

I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at any post office. You should see the refund within 3-5 business days after we receive it.
That's perfect. Thank you again, Sarah. Happy holidays!
You're very welcome. Happy holidays to you too, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
